note: Plugin-owned recipes for Govel Admin Jobs. Create after installing/activating govel-syncio. Core does not seed Syncio jobs. Syncio consumes govel-shopify shops by govel_shop_id. Apply paths call govel-shopify POST /api/inventory/set, PATCH /api/products/{id}, POST /api/products (requires catalog.inventory_write / catalog.product_write scopes on destinations).

config.note: Persists govel_syncio_product_mapping rows (also mirrored in plugin JSON store).
Plans deltas from ListProducts inventory_quantity; apply calls POST /api/inventory/set (catalog.inventory_write).
Pushes toggled attributes via PATCH /api/products/{id}; create-missing via POST /api/products when connection.create_missing_products (catalog.product_write).
